newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil prepares for Gullfaks satellites.
newsitem.headline: Statoil prepares for Gullfaks satellites.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil ) said on Thursday transport of a pig launcher module from Kvaerner Egersund yard to the Gullfaks A platform in the North Sea would begin at the weekend.
The unit forms part of the Gullfaks satellite development, which comprises Gullfaks South, Rimfaks and Gullveig.
The offshore lifting operation is planned for the first week of July and will be followed immediately by hook-up work, which is scheduled for the August turnaround of Gullfaks A.
Statoil plans to hook up a gas treatment module to the platform next April. The satellites are due to come onstream in October, 1998.
